metaDescription: Kayen Premium Select bell pepper is a bell pepper variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
keywords: Kayen Premium Select bell pepper variety
excerpt: Kayen Premium Select is a bell pepper variety, also sold or known as Kayen or Pepper Sweet Kayen. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Kayen Premium Select bell pepper is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Kayen or Pepper Sweet Kayen, this is the same bell pepper. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [bell pepper variety finder](/crop-varieties/bell-pepper), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit bell pepper fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 70 to 90 days after transplanting (professional page), 65 days on the garden packet page.
**Fruit:** Long sweet pepper, not blocky: mild and crisp, red when fully ripe.
**Season:** Dry season in the lowlands (the garden packet page says all season in midland to highland).
Tolerant to bacterial wilt, anthracnose, virus, late blight and leaf spot (seller's claim).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: Ramgo's long sweet pepper, in its professional line and garden packets, only the seller's pages found. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual bell pepper on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Kayen Premium Select bell pepper

Bell pepper does best in cool places such as Benguet and Bukidnon. In the lowlands, pick a heat tolerant hybrid and grow it in the dry season under some shade. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is Kayen the same as Kayen Premium Select?
items.a: Yes. Kayen is another name for Kayen Premium Select. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Kayen Premium Select?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
